description: Unit tests for the ImmutableJsonPointer class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package, testing parsing, equality, mutability, and pointer manipulation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPointerTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableJsonPointer, contains various test cases checking parsing, equality, boundary conditions, and pointer modifications.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutableJsonPointer instances are immutable and their JsonKey components are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementation for ImmutableJsonPointer.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithLeadingSlash
methods.description: Tests creation of a JsonPointer from a string with a leading slash.

methods.name: createInstanceFromSlash
methods.description: Tests creation from a single slash, expecting an empty pointer.

methods.name: emptyPointerEqualsPointerWithOneSlash
methods.description: Checks that the empty pointer equals a pointer created from a slash.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTrailingSlash
methods.description: Tests creation with a trailing slash in the string.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoDelimitingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception handling for consecutive slashes.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoStartingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception for starting with double slashes.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoEndingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception for ending with double slashes.

methods.name: assertConsecutiveSlashesExceptionFor
methods.description: Helper for asserting JsonPointerInvalidException due to improper slashes.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests retrieving levels by index in the pointer.

methods.name: getLevelsCountReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the level count retrieval.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Ensures null string parsing throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseSlashDelimitedStringToGetAJsonPointerInstance
methods.description: Tests parsing a slash-delimited string with trailing slash.

methods.name: iterationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies iteration over JsonPointer yields the correct sequence.

methods.name: iteratorIsImmutable
methods.description: Ensures iterator cannot modify the JsonPointer.

methods.name: addingNewLevelReturnsNewJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests addition of a leaf to a pointer creates a new instance.

methods.name: tryToAddNullLeaf
methods.description: Checks that adding a null leaf throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromRootPointer
methods.description: Tests creation from root slash.

methods.name: getSubPointerWithNegativeLevelNumber
methods.description: Ensures negative index returns empty Optional.

methods.name: getSubPointerWithTooHighLevelNumberReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Ensures high index returns empty Optional.

methods.name: getSubPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks subpointer extraction at a specific level.

methods.name: createPointerWithOrWithoutLeadingSlashIsTheSame
methods.description: Verifies parsing with or without leading slash yields equal pointers.

methods.name: cutLeafWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Removes last leaf, verifying the returned pointer and leaf key.

methods.name: appendSubPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests appending a sub-pointer.

methods.name: appendEmptySubPointerReturnsSamePointer
methods.description: Checks that appending an empty pointer does not change the original.

methods.name: createInstanceFromParsedStringWithEscapedTildesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Ensures parsing of escaped tilde sequences.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonKeysWithEscapedTildesAndSlashesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks the correct string representation when JsonKeys have escaped characters.
